QuestInfo.name: Taboo Priest
QuestInfo.1: A Barrier Totem is needed to stop Lich's forbidden magic. To make a Barrier Totem, you must get Lich's #bRed Contract Orb and Bible of the Corrupt#k.\r\n\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the Bible of the Corrupt and Red Contract Orb.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 628,622
Can proceed to the Barrier Totem quest

0.msg: I think #bLich#k is behind this. This reeks of forbidden magic. Seems some of that #bmagician's#k research survived. Lich must have gotten a hold of it.

1.msg: Then we should go defeat them quickly. We don't know when the zombies will attack the town again...

2.msg: Wait. Lich is not an easy monster to defeat. You must cut off its magic source to defeat it. But no one has found the source...even I couldn't find it. Unless we stop the source, Lich will revive again no matter how many time we do this.

4.msg: We can't stop Lich from reviving, but we can stop it from using forbidden magic. We can put a barrier around the Forest of Dead Trees so that Lich cannot create more zombies. Want to give it a try?

yes.0: To set up the barrier, we need to make a #bBarrier Totem#k. I can use my magic to make one, but I need Lich's #bRed Contract Orb#k and #bBible of the Corrupt#k. Can you get them for me?
yes.1: To set up the barrier, we need to make a #bBarrier Totem#k. I can use my magic to make one, but I need Lich's #bRed Contract Orb#k and #bBible of the Corrupt#k. Can you get them?

no.0: Patience is a virtue, my friend...

0.0: You brought all the samples I requested. Will you wait a moment? I'll let you know what I find as soon as I examine the samples.

item.0: I need Lich's #bRed Contract Orb#k and #bBible of the Corrupt#k to create the Barrier Totem.
